title: Sturdy & Stable!
text: Sturdy & Stable!. We needed more storage space, so we ordered these for our guest room. They are sturdy. There are a few different options as to how high you raise the bed. I only wish they came in the quantity of 5. The queen bed we're using these on has a center support, so we need one more. Instead of ordering another set of 4, my husband rigged up something out of wood. That is working, but it would have been nicer if there were 5 of the same.
